text_en: The word of the Lord , that came to Micheas, the Morasthite, in the days of Joathan, Achaz , and Ezechias , kings of Juda : which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .
text_la: Verbum Domini, quod factum est ad Michæam Morasthiten, in diebus Joathan, Achaz, et Ezechiæ, regum Juda, quod vidit super Samariam et Jerusalem.
text_pt: Palavra do SENHOR, que veio a Miquéias, morastita, nos dias de Jotão, Acaz e Ezequias, reis de Judá, a qual ele viu sobre Samaria e Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Μιχαιαν τὸν τοῦ Μωρασθι ἐν ἡμέραις Ιωαθαμ καὶ Αχαζ καὶ Εζεκιου βασιλέων Ιουδα ὑπὲρ ὧν εἶδεν περὶ Σαμαρείας καὶ περὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Hear, all you people: and let the earth give ear, and all that is therein: and let the Lord God be a witness to you, the Lord from his holy temple .
text_la: Audite, populi omnes, et attendat terra, et plenitudo ejus : et sit Dominus Deus vobis in testem, Dominus de templo sancto suo.
text_pt: Ouvi, todos os povos, presta atenção, ó terra, e tudo o que nela há; e seja o Senhor DEUS testemunha contra vós, o Senhor, desde o seu santo templo.
text_el: ἀκούσατε λαοί λόγους καὶ προσεχέτω ἡ γῆ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἔσται κύριος ἐν ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον κύριος ἐξ οἴκου ἁγίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: For behold the Lord will come forth out of his place: and he will come down, and will tread upon the high places of the earth.
text_la: Quia ecce Dominus egredietur de loco suo, et descendet, et calcabit super excelsa terræ.
text_pt: Porque eis que o Senhor está para sair do seu lugar, e descerá, e andará sobre as alturas da terra.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ κύριος ἐκπορεύεται ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ καὶ καταβήσεται καὶ ἐπιβήσεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the mountains shall be melted under him: and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as waters that run down a steep place.
text_la: Et consumentur montes subtus eum, et valles scindentur sicut cera a facie ignis, et sicut aquæ quæ decurrunt in præceps.
text_pt: E os montes debaixo dele se derreterão, e os vales se fenderão, como a cera diante do fogo, como as águas que se precipitam num abismo.
text_el: καὶ σαλευθήσεται τὰ ὄρη ὑποκάτωθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ κοιλάδες τακήσονται ὡς κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου πυρὸς καὶ ὡς ὕδωρ καταφερόμενον ἐν καταβάσει

text_en: For the wickedness of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the wickedness of Jacob ? Is it not Samaria ? And what are the high places of Juda ? Are they not Jerusalem ?
text_la: In scelere Jacob omne istud, et in peccatis domus Israël. Quod scelus Jacob? nonne Samaria? et quæ excelsa Judæ? nonne Jerusalem?
text_pt: Tudo isto por causa da transgressão de Jacó, e dos pecados da casa de Israel. Qual é a transgressão de Jacó? Não é Samaria? E quais os altos de Judá? Não é Jerusalém?
text_el: διὰ ἀσέβειαν Ιακωβ πάντα ταῦτα καὶ διὰ ἁμαρτίαν οἴκου Ισραηλ τίς ἡ ἀσέβεια τοῦ Ιακωβ οὐ Σαμάρεια καὶ τίς ἡ ἁμαρτία οἴκου Ιουδα οὐχὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And I will make Samaria as a heap of stones in the field when a vineyard is planted: and I will bring down the stones thereof into the valley, and will lay her foundations bare.
text_la: Et ponam Samariam quasi acervum lapidum in agro, cum plantatur vinea; et detraham in vallem lapides ejus, et fundamenta ejus revelabo.
text_pt: Por isso farei de Samaria um montão de pedras do campo, uma terra de plantar vinhas, e farei rolar as suas pedras no vale, e descobrirei os seus fundamentos.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι Σαμάρειαν εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ἀγροῦ καὶ εἰς φυτείαν ἀμπελῶνος καὶ κατασπάσω εἰς χάος τοὺς λίθους αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς ἀποκαλύψω

text_en: And all her graven things shall be cut in pieces, and all her wages shall be burnt with fire, and I will bring to destruction all her idols : for they were gathered together of the hire of a harlot, and unto the hire of a harlot they shall return.
text_la: Et omnia sculptilia ejus concidentur, et omnes mercedes ejus comburentur igne, et omnia idola ejus ponam in perditionem, quia de mercedibus meretricis congregata sunt, et usque ad mercedem meretricis revertentur.
text_pt: E todas as suas imagens de escultura serão despedaçadas, e todas as suas ofertas serão queimadas pelo fogo, e de todos os seus ídolos eu farei uma assolação; porque pela paga de prostituta os ajuntou, e para a paga de prostituta voltarão.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῆς κατακόψουσιν καὶ πάντα τὰ μισθώματα αὐτῆς ἐμπρήσουσιν ἐν πυρί καὶ πάντα τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῆς θήσομαι εἰς ἀφανισμόν διότι ἐκ μισθωμάτων πορνείας συνήγαγεν καὶ ἐκ μισθωμάτων πορνείας συνέστρεψεν

text_en: Therefore will I lament, and howl: I will go stript and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and a mourning like the ostriches.
text_la: Super hoc plangam, et ululabo; vadam spoliatus, et nudus; faciam planctum velut draconum, et luctum quasi struthionum :
text_pt: Por isso lamentarei, e gemerei, andarei despojado e nu; farei lamentação como de chacais, e pranto como de avestruzes.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου κόψεται καὶ θρηνήσει πορεύσεται ἀνυπόδετος καὶ γυμνή ποιήσεται κοπετὸν ὡς δρακόντων καὶ πένθος ὡς θυγατέρων σειρήνων

text_en: Because her wound is desperate, because it has come even to Juda , it has touched the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem .
text_la: quia desperata est plaga ejus, quia venit usque ad Judam; tetigit portam populi mei usque ad Jerusalem.
text_pt: Porque a sua chaga é incurável, porque chegou até Judá; estendeu-se até à porta do meu povo, até Jerusalém.
text_el: ὅτι κατεκράτησεν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς διότι ἦλθεν ἕως Ιουδα καὶ ἥψατο ἕως πύλης λαοῦ μου ἕως Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Declare it not in Geth, weep not with tears: in the house of Dust sprinkle yourselves with dust.
text_la: In Geth nolite annuntiare; lacrimis ne ploretis; in domo pulveris pulvere vos conspergite.
text_pt: Não o anuncieis em Gate, nem choreis muito; revolve-te no pó, na casa de Afra.
text_el: οἱ ἐν Γεθ μὴ μεγαλύνεσθε οἱ ἐν Ακιμ μὴ ἀνοικοδομεῖτε ἐξ οἴκου κατὰ γέλωτα γῆν καταπάσασθε κατὰ γέλωτα ὑμῶν

text_en: And pass away, O you that dwell in the beautiful place, covered with your shame: she went not forth that dwells in the confines: the house adjoining shall receive mourning from you, which stood by herself.
text_la: Et transite vobis, habitatio pulchra, confusa ignominia : non est egressa quæ habitat in exitu : planctum domus vicina accipiet ex vobis, quæ stetit sibimet.
text_pt: Passa, ó moradora de Safir, em vergonhosa nudez; a moradora de Zaanã não saiu; o pranto de Bete-Ezel tirará de vós a sua posição.
text_el: κατοικοῦσα καλῶς τὰς πόλεις αὐτῆς οὐκ ἐξῆλθεν κατοικοῦσα Σεννααν κόψασθαι οἶκον ἐχόμενον αὐτῆς λήμψεται ἐξ ὑμῶν πληγὴν ὀδύνης

text_en: For she has become weak unto good that dwells in bitterness: for evil has come down from the Lord into the gate of Jerusalem .
text_la: Quia infirmata est in bonum, quæ habitat in amaritudinibus; quia descendit malum a Domino in portam Jerusalem.
text_pt: Porque a moradora de Marote sofre pelo bem; porque desceu do Senhor o mal até à porta de Jerusalém.
text_el: τίς ἤρξατο εἰς ἀγαθὰ κατοικούσῃ ὀδύνας ὅτι κατέβη κακὰ παρὰ κυρίου ἐπὶ πύλας Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: A tumult of chariots has astonished the inhabitants of Lachis: it is the beginning of sin to the daughter of Sion for in you were found the crimes of Israel .
text_la: Tumultus quadrigæ stuporis habitanti Lachis : principium peccati est filiæ Sion, quia in te inventa sunt scelera Israël.
text_pt: Ata os animais ligeiros ao carro, ó moradora de Laquis; esta foi o princípio do pecado para a filha de Sião, porque em ti se acharam as transgressões de Israel.
text_el: ψόφος ἁρμάτων καὶ ἱππευόντων κατοικοῦσα Λαχις ἀρχηγὸς ἁμαρτίας αὐτή ἐστιν τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιων ὅτι ἐν σοὶ εὑρέθησαν ἀσέβειαι τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore shall she send messengers to the inheritance of Geth: the houses of lying to deceive the kings of Israel .
text_la: Propterea dabit emissarios super hæreditatem Geth, domus mendacii in deceptionem regibus Israël.
text_pt: Por isso darás presentes a Moresete-Gate; as casas de Aczibe se tornarão em engano para os reis de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο δώσεις ἐξαποστελλομένους ἕως κληρονομίας Γεθ οἴκους ματαίους εἰς κενὰ ἐγένετο τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Yet will I bring an heir to you that dwell in Maresa: even to Odollam shall the glory of Israel come.
text_la: Adhuc hæredem adducam tibi quæ habitas in Maresa; usque ad Odollam veniet gloria Israël.
text_pt: Ainda trarei a ti, ó moradora de Maressa, aquele que te possuirá; chegará até Adulão a glória de Israel.
text_el: ἕως τοὺς κληρονόμους ἀγάγω σοι κατοικοῦσα Λαχις κληρονομία ἕως Οδολλαμ ἥξει ἡ δόξα τῆς θυγατρὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: Make you bald, and be polled for your delicate children: enlarge your baldness as the eagle: for they are carried into captivity from you.
text_la: Decalvare, et tondere super filios deliciarum tuarum; dilata calvitium tuum sicut aquila, quoniam captivi ducti sunt ex te.
text_pt: Faze-te calva, e tosquia-te, por causa dos filhos das tuas delícias; alarga a tua calva como a águia, porque de ti foram levados cativos.
text_el: ξύρησαι καὶ κεῖραι ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα τὰ τρυφερά σου ἐμπλάτυνον τὴν χηρείαν σου ὡς ἀετός ὅτι ᾐχμαλωτεύθησαν ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: Woe to you that devise that which is unprofitable, and work evil in your beds: in the morning light they execute it, because their hand is against God .
text_la: Væ qui cogitatis inutile, et operamini malum in cubilibus vestris! In luce matutina faciunt illud, quoniam contra Deum est manus eorum.
text_pt: Ai daqueles que nas suas camas intentam a iniqüidade, e maquinam o mal; à luz da alva o praticam, porque está no poder da sua mão!
text_el: ἐγένοντο λογιζόμενοι κόπους καὶ ἐργαζόμενοι κακὰ ἐν ταῖς κοίταις αὐτῶν καὶ ἅμα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ συνετέλουν αὐτά διότι οὐκ ἦραν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: And they have coveted fields, and taken them by violence , and houses they have forcibly taken away: and oppressed a man and his house, a man and his inheritance.
text_la: Et concupierunt agros, et violenter tulerunt : et rapuerunt domos, et calumniabantur virum, et domum ejus : virum, et hæreditatem ejus.
text_pt: E cobiçam campos, e roubam-nos, cobiçam casas, e arrebatam-nas; assim fazem violência a um homem e à sua casa, a uma pessoa e à sua herança.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεθύμουν ἀγροὺς καὶ διήρπαζον ὀρφανοὺς καὶ οἴκους κατεδυνάστευον καὶ διήρπαζον ἄνδρα καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἄνδρα καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Behold I devise an evil against this family : from which you shall not withdraw your necks, and you shall not walk haughtily, for this is a very evil time.
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego cogito super familiam istam malum, unde non auferetis colla vestra, et non ambulabitis superbi : quoniam tempus pessimum est.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor: Eis que projeto um mal contra esta família, do qual não tirareis os vossos pescoços, e não andareis tão altivos, porque o tempo será mau.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λογίζομαι ἐπὶ τὴν φυλὴν ταύτην κακά ἐξ ὧν οὐ μὴ ἄρητε τοὺς τραχήλους ὑμῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀρθοὶ ἐξαίφνης ὅτι καιρὸς πονηρός ἐστιν

text_en: In that day a parable shall be taken up upon you, and a song shall be sung with melody by them that say: We are laid waste and spoiled: the portion of my people is changed: how shall he depart from me, whereas he is returning that will divide our land?
text_la: In die illa sumetur super vos parabola, et cantabitur canticum cum suavitate, dicentium : Depopulatione vastati sumus; pars populi mei commutata est : quomodo recedet a me, cum revertatur, qui regiones nostras dividat?
text_pt: Naquele dia se levantará sobre vós um provérbio, e se lamentará pranto lastimoso, dizendo: Nós estamos inteiramente desolados; a porção do meu povo ele a troca; como me despoja! Tira os nossos campos e os reparte!
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λημφθήσεται ἐφ' ὑμᾶς παραβολή καὶ θρηνηθήσεται θρῆνος ἐν μέλει λέγων ταλαιπωρίᾳ ἐταλαιπωρήσαμεν μερὶς λαοῦ μου κατεμετρήθη ἐν σχοινίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ κωλύσων αὐτὸν τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι οἱ ἀγροὶ ἡμῶν διεμερίσθησαν

text_en: Therefore you shall have none that shall cast the cord of a lot in the assembly of the Lord .
text_la: Propter hoc non erit tibi mittens funiculum sortis in cœtu Domini.
text_pt: Portanto, não terás tu na congregação do Senhor quem lance o cordel pela sorte.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔσται σοι βάλλων σχοινίον ἐν κλήρῳ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ κυρίου

text_en: Speak not, saying: It shall not drop upon these, confusion shall not take them.
text_la: Ne loquamini loquentes; non stillabit super istos, non comprehendet confusio.
text_pt: Não profetizeis aos que profetizam; eles não profetizarão para eles, pois não se apartará a sua vergonha.
text_el: μὴ κλαίετε δάκρυσιν μηδὲ δακρυέτωσαν ἐπὶ τούτοις οὐ γὰρ ἀπώσεται ὀνείδη

text_en: The house of Jacob says: Is the Spirit of the Lord straitened or are these his thoughts? Are not my words good to him that walks uprightly?
text_la: Dicit domus Jacob : Numquid abbreviatus est spiritus Domini, aut tales sunt cogitationes ejus? nonne verba mea bona sunt cum eo qui recte graditur?
text_pt: Ó vós que sois chamados casa de Jacó, porventura encurtou-se o Espírito do Senhor? São estas as suas obras? E não é assim que fazem bem as minhas palavras ao que anda retamente?
text_el: ὁ λέγων οἶκος Ιακωβ παρώργισεν πνεῦμα κυρίου εἰ ταῦτα τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτοῦ ἐστιν οὐχ οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ εἰσιν καλοὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ὀρθοὶ πεπόρευνται

text_en: But my people, on the contrary, are risen up as an enemy: you have taken away the cloak off from the coat: and them that passed harmless you have turned to war .
text_la: et e contrario populus meus in adversarium consurrexit. Desuper tunica pallium sustulistis : et eos qui transibant simpliciter convertistis in bellum.
text_pt: Mas ontem, se levantou o meu povo como inimigo; de sobre a vestidura tirastes a capa daqueles que passavam seguros, como homens que voltavam da guerra.
text_el: καὶ ἔμπροσθεν ὁ λαός μου εἰς ἔχθραν ἀντέστη κατέναντι τῆς εἰρήνης αὐτοῦ τὴν δορὰν αὐτοῦ ἐξέδειραν τοῦ ἀφελέσθαι ἐλπίδα συντριμμὸν πολέμου

text_en: You have cast out the women of my people from their houses, in which they took delight: you have taken my praise forever from their children.
text_la: Mulieres populi mei ejecistis de domo deliciarum suarum; a parvulis earum tulistis laudem meam in perpetuum.
text_pt: Lançastes fora as mulheres do meu povo, da casa das suas delícias; das suas crianças tirastes para sempre a minha glória.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἡγούμενοι λαοῦ μου ἀπορριφήσονται ἐκ τῶν οἰκιῶν τρυφῆς αὐτῶν διὰ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν ἐξώσθησαν ἐγγίσατε ὄρεσιν αἰωνίοις

text_en: Arise and depart, for there is no rest here for you. For that uncleanness of the land, it shall be corrupted with a grievous corruption.
text_la: Surgite, et ite, quia non habetis hic requiem : propter immunditiam ejus corrumpetur putredine pessima.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, e ide-vos, porque este não é lugar de descanso; por causa da imundícia que traz destruição, sim, destruição enorme.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι καὶ πορεύου ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν σοι αὕτη ἡ ἀνάπαυσις ἕνεκεν ἀκαθαρσίας διεφθάρητε φθορᾷ

text_en: Would God I were not a man that has the spirit, and that I rather spoke a lie: I will let drop to you of wine, and of drunkenness: and it shall be this people upon whom it shall drop.
text_la: Utinam non essem vir habens spiritum, et mendacium potius loquerer! Stillabo tibi in vinum et in ebrietatem; et erit super quem stillatur populus iste.
text_pt: Se houver alguém que, andando com espírito de falsidade, mentir, dizendo: Eu te profetizarei sobre o vinho e a bebida forte; será esse tal o profeta deste povo.
text_el: κατεδιώχθητε οὐδενὸς διώκοντος πνεῦμα ἔστησεν ψεῦδος ἐστάλαξέν σοι εἰς οἶνον καὶ μέθυσμα καὶ ἔσται ἐκ τῆς σταγόνος τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου

text_en: I will assemble and gather together all of you, O Jacob : I will bring together the remnant of Israel , I will put them together as a flock in the fold, as sheep in the midst of the sheepcotes, they shall make a tumult by reason of the multitude of men .
text_la: Congregatione congregabo, Jacob, totum te; in unum conducam reliquias Israël : pariter ponam illum quasi gregem in ovili, quasi pecus in medio caularum : tumultuabuntur a multitudine hominum.
text_pt: Certamente te ajuntarei todo, ó Jacó; certamente congregarei o restante de Israel; pô-los-ei todos juntos, como ovelhas de Bozra; como o rebanho no meio do seu pasto, farão estrondo por causa da multidão dos homens.
text_el: συναγόμενος συναχθήσεται Ιακωβ σὺν πᾶσιν ἐκδεχόμενος ἐκδέξομαι τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ θήσομαι τὴν ἀποστροφὴν αὐτῶν ὡς πρόβατα ἐν θλίψει ὡς ποίμνιον ἐν μέσῳ κοίτης αὐτῶν ἐξαλοῦνται ἐξ ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For he shall go up that shall open the way before them: they shall divide and pass through the gate, and shall come in by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the Lord at the head of them.
text_la: Ascendet enim pandens iter ante eos : divident, et transibunt portam, et ingredientur per eam : et transibit rex eorum coram eis, et Dominus in capite eorum.
text_pt: Subirá diante deles o que abrirá o caminho; eles romperão, e entrarão pela porta, e sairão por ela; e o rei irá adiante deles, e o Senhor à testa deles.
text_el: διὰ τῆς διακοπῆς πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν διέκοψαν καὶ διῆλθον πύλην καὶ ἐξῆλθον δι' αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς αὐτῶν πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ὁ δὲ κύριος ἡγήσεται αὐτῶν

text_en: And I said: Hear, O you princes of Jacob , and you chiefs of the house of Israel : Is it not your part to know judgment,
text_la: Et dixi : Audite, princeps Jacob, et duces domus Israël : numquid non vestrum est scire judicium,
text_pt: E disse eu: Ouvi, peço-vos, ó chefes de Jacó, e vós, príncipes da casa de Israel; não é a vós que pertence saber o juízo?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ ἀκούσατε δὴ ταῦτα αἱ ἀρχαὶ οἴκου Ιακωβ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι οἴκου Ισραηλ οὐχ ὑμῖν ἐστιν τοῦ γνῶναι τὸ κρίμα

text_en: you that hate good , and love evil : that violently pluck off their skins from them and their flesh from their bones?
text_la: qui odio habetis bonum, et diligitis malum; qui violenter tollitis pelles eorum desuper eis, et carnem eorum desuper ossibus eorum;
text_pt: A vós que odiais o bem, e amais o mal, que arrancais a pele de cima deles, e a carne de cima dos seus ossos;
text_el: οἱ μισοῦντες τὰ καλὰ καὶ ζητοῦντες τὰ πονηρά ἁρπάζοντες τὰ δέρματα αὐτῶν ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτῶν

text_en: Who have eaten the flesh of my people, and have flayed their skin off them: and have broken, and chopped their bones as for the kettle, and as flesh in the midst of the pot.
text_la: qui comederunt carnem populi mei, et pellem eorum desuper excoriaverunt, et ossa eorum confregerunt, et conciderunt sicut in lebete, et quasi carnem in medio ollæ?
text_pt: E que comeis a carne do meu povo, e lhes arrancais a pele, e lhes esmiuçais os ossos, e os repartis como para a panela e como carne dentro do caldeirão.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον κατέφαγον τὰς σάρκας τοῦ λαοῦ μου καὶ τὰ δέρματα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτῶν ἐξέδειραν καὶ τὰ ὀστέα αὐτῶν συνέθλασαν καὶ ἐμέλισαν ὡς σάρκας εἰς λέβητα καὶ ὡς κρέα εἰς χύτραν

text_en: Then shall they cry to the Lord , and he will not hear them: and he will hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved wickedly in their devices.
text_la: Tunc clamabunt ad Dominum, et non exaudiet eos, et abscondet faciem suam ab eis in tempore illo, sicut nequiter egerunt in adinventionibus suis.
text_pt: Então clamarão ao Senhor, mas não os ouvirá; antes esconderá deles a sua face naquele tempo, visto que eles fizeram mal nas suas obras.
text_el: οὕτως κεκράξονται πρὸς κύριον καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσεται αὐτῶν καὶ ἀποστρέψει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀνθ' ὧν ἐπονηρεύσαντο ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: Thus says the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err : that bite with their teeth, and preach peace: and if a man give not something into their mouth, they prepare war against him.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus super prophetas, qui seducunt populum meum : qui mordent dentibus suis, et prædicant pacem; et si quis non dederit in ore eorum quippiam, sanctificant super eum prælium.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor acerca dos profetas que fazem errar o meu povo, que mordem com os seus dentes, e clamam paz; mas contra aquele que nada lhes dá na boca preparam guerra.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πλανῶντας τὸν λαόν μου τοὺς δάκνοντας ἐν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσοντας ἐπ' αὐτὸν εἰρήνην καὶ οὐκ ἐδόθη εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ἤγειραν ἐπ' αὐτὸν πόλεμον

text_en: Therefore night shall be to you instead of vision, and darkness to you instead of divination : and the sun shall go down upon the prophets , and the day shall be darkened over them.
text_la: Propterea nox vobis pro visione erit, et tenebræ vobis pro divinatione; et occumbet sol super prophetas, et obtenebrabitur super eos dies.
text_pt: Portanto, se vos fará noite sem visão, e tereis trevas sem adivinhação, e haverá o sol sobre os profetas, e o dia sobre eles se enegrecerá.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο νὺξ ὑμῖν ἔσται ἐξ ὁράσεως καὶ σκοτία ὑμῖν ἔσται ἐκ μαντείας καὶ δύσεται ὁ ἥλιος ἐπὶ τοὺς προφήτας καὶ συσκοτάσει ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἡ ἡμέρα

text_en: And they shall be confounded that see visions, and the diviners shall be confounded: and they shall all cover their faces, because there is no answer of God .
text_la: Et confundentur qui vident visiones, et confundentur divini; et operient omnes vultos suos, quia non est responsum Dei.
text_pt: E os videntes se envergonharão, e os adivinhadores se confundirão; sim, todos eles cobrirão os seus lábios, porque não haverá resposta de Deus.
text_el: καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται οἱ ὁρῶντες τὰ ἐνύπνια καὶ καταγελασθήσονται οἱ μάντεις καὶ καταλαλήσουσιν κατ' αὐτῶν πάντες αὐτοί διότι οὐκ ἔσται ὁ εἰσακούων αὐτῶν

text_en: But yet I am filled with the strength of the spirit of the Lord , with judgment and power: to declare unto Jacob his wickedness and to Israel his sin .
text_la: Verumtamen ego repletus sum fortitudine spiritus Domini, judicio, et virtute, ut annuntiem Jacob scelus suum, et Israël peccatum suum.
text_pt: Mas eu estou cheio do poder do Espírito do Senhor, e de juízo e de força, para anunciar a Jacó a sua transgressão e a Israel o seu pecado.
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ ἐγὼ ἐμπλήσω ἰσχὺν ἐν πνεύματι κυρίου καὶ κρίματος καὶ δυναστείας τοῦ ἀπαγγεῖλαι τῷ Ιακωβ ἀσεβείας αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ Ισραηλ ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hear this, you princes of the house of Jacob , and you judges of the house of Israel : you that abhor judgment and pervert all that is right.
text_la: Audite hoc, principes domus Jacob, et judices domus Israël, qui abominamini judicium, et omnia recta pervertitis :
text_pt: Ouvi agora isto, vós, chefes da casa de Jacó, e príncipes da casa de Israel, que abominais o juízo e perverteis tudo o que é direito,
text_el: ἀκούσατε δὴ ταῦτα οἱ ἡγούμενοι οἴκου Ιακωβ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι οἴκου Ισραηλ οἱ βδελυσσόμενοι κρίμα καὶ πάντα τὰ ὀρθὰ διαστρέφοντες

text_en: You that build up Sion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity .
text_la: qui ædificatis Sion in sanguinibus, et Jerusalem in iniquitate.
text_pt: Edificando a Sião com sangue, e a Jerusalém com iniqüidade.
text_el: οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες Σιων ἐν αἵμασιν καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἀδικίαις

text_en: Her princes have judged for bribes : and her priests have taught for hire, and her prophets divined for money: and they leaned upon the Lord , saying: Is not the Lord in the midst of us? no evil shall come among us.
text_la: Principes ejus in muneribus judicabant, et sacerdotes ejus in mercede docebant, et prophetæ ejus in pecunia divinabant : et super Dominum requiescebant, dicentes : Numquid non Dominus in medio nostrum? non venient super nos mala.
text_pt: Os seus chefes dão as sentenças por suborno, e os seus sacerdotes ensinam por interesse, e os seus profetas adivinham por dinheiro; e ainda se encostam ao Senhor, dizendo: Não está o Senhor no meio de nós? Nenhum mal nos sobrevirá.
text_el: οἱ ἡγούμενοι αὐτῆς μετὰ δώρων ἔκρινον καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς μετὰ μισθοῦ ἀπεκρίνοντο καὶ οἱ προφῆται αὐτῆς μετὰ ἀργυρίου ἐμαντεύοντο καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἐπανεπαύοντο λέγοντες οὐχὶ κύριος ἐν ἡμῖν ἐστιν οὐ μὴ ἐπέλθῃ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς κακά

text_en: Therefore because of you, Sion shall be ploughed as a field, and Jerusalem shall be as a heap of stones, and the mountain of the temple as the high places of the forests.
text_la: Propter hoc, causa vestri, Sion quasi ager arabitur, et Jerusalem quasi acervus lapidum erit, et mons templi in excelsa silvarum.
text_pt: Portanto, por causa de vós, Sião será lavrada como um campo, e Jerusalém se tornará em montões de pedras, e o monte desta casa como os altos de um bosque.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο δι' ὑμᾶς Σιων ὡς ἀγρὸς ἀροτριαθήσεται καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ὡς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ἔσται καὶ τὸ ὄρος τοῦ οἴκου ὡς ἄλσος δρυμοῦ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be prepared in the top of the mountains, and high above the hills: and people shall flow to it.
text_la: Et erit : in novissimo dierum erit mons domus Domini præparatus in vertice montium, et sublimis super colles : et fluent ad eum populi,
text_pt: Mas nos últimos dias acontecerá que o monte da casa do SENHOR será estabelecido no cume dos montes, e se elevará sobre os outeiros, e a ele afluirão os povos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐμφανὲς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ κυρίου ἕτοιμον ἐπὶ τὰς κορυφὰς τῶν ὀρέων καὶ μετεωρισθήσεται ὑπεράνω τῶν βουνῶν καὶ σπεύσουσιν πρὸς αὐτὸ λαοί

text_en: And many nations shall come in haste, and say: Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , and to the house of the God of Jacob : and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth out of Sion, and the word of the Lord out of Jerusalem .
text_la: et properabunt gentes multæ, et dicent : Venite, ascendamus ad montem Domini, et ad domum Dei Jacob : et docebit nos de viis suis, et ibimus in semitis ejus, quia de Sion egredietur lex, et verbum Domini de Jerusalem.
text_pt: E irão muitas nações, e dirão: Vinde, e subamos ao monte do Senhor, e à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que nos ensine os seus caminhos, e andemos pelas suas veredas; porque de Sião sairá a lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται ἔθνη πολλὰ καὶ ἐροῦσιν δεῦτε ἀναβῶμεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος κυρίου καὶ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ Ιακωβ καὶ δείξουσιν ἡμῖν τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πορευσόμεθα ἐν ταῖς τρίβοις αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐκ Σιων ἐξελεύσεται νόμος καὶ λόγος κυρίου ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off: and they shall beat their swords into ploughshares, and their spears into spades: nation shall not take sword against nation: neither shall they learn war anymore.
text_la: Et judicabit inter populos multos, et corripiet gentes fortes usque in longinquum : et concident gladios suos in vomeres, et hastas suas in ligones : non sumet gens adversus gentem gladium, et non discent ultra belligerare.
text_pt: E julgará entre muitos povos, e castigará nações poderosas e longínquas, e converterão as suas espadas em pás, e as suas lanças em foices; uma nação não levantará a espada contra outra nação, nem aprenderão mais a guerra.
text_el: καὶ κρινεῖ ἀνὰ μέσον λαῶν πολλῶν καὶ ἐξελέγξει ἔθνη ἰσχυρὰ ἕως εἰς γῆν μακράν καὶ κατακόψουσιν τὰς ῥομφαίας αὐτῶν εἰς ἄροτρα καὶ τὰ δόρατα αὐτῶν εἰς δρέπανα καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ ἀντάρῃ ἔθνος ἐπ' ἔθνος ῥομφαίαν καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ μάθωσιν πολεμεῖν

text_en: And every man shall sit under his vine, and under his fig tree, and there shall be none to make them afraid, for the mouth of the Lord of hosts has spoken.
text_la: Et sedebit vir subtus vitem suam et subtus ficum suam, et non erit qui deterreat, quia os Domini exercituum locutum est.
text_pt: Mas assentar-se-á cada um debaixo da sua videira, e debaixo da sua figueira, e não haverá quem os espante, porque a boca do Senhor dos Exércitos o disse.
text_el: καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ἕκαστος ὑποκάτω ἀμπέλου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος ὑποκάτω συκῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἐκφοβῶν διότι τὸ στόμα κυρίου παντοκράτορος ἐλάλησεν ταῦτα

text_en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god: but we will walk in the name of the Lord , our God , for ever and ever.
text_la: Quia omnes populi ambulabunt unusquisque in nomine dei sui; nos autem ambulabimus in nomine Domini Dei nostri, in æternum et ultra.
text_pt: Porque todos os povos andam, cada um em nome do seu deus; mas nós andaremos em nome do Senhor nosso Deus, para todo o sempre.
text_el: ὅτι πάντες οἱ λαοὶ πορεύσονται ἕκαστος τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ ἡμεῖς δὲ πορευσόμεθα ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ἐπέκεινα

text_en: In that day, says the Lord , I will gather up her that halts: and her that I had cast out, I will gather up: and her whom I had afflicted.
text_la: In die illa, dicit Dominus, congregabo claudicantem, et eam quam ejeceram colligam, et quam afflixeram :
text_pt: Naquele dia, diz o Senhor, congregarei a que coxeava, e recolherei a que tinha sido expulsa, e a que eu tinha maltratado.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγει κύριος συνάξω τὴν συντετριμμένην καὶ τὴν ἐξωσμένην εἰσδέξομαι καὶ οὓς ἀπωσάμην

text_en: And I will make her that halted, a remnant: and her that had been afflicted, a mighty nation: and the Lord will reign over them in Mount Sion, from this time now and forever.
text_la: et ponam claudicantem in reliquias, et eam quæ laboraverat, in gentem robustam : et regnabit Dominus super eos in monte Sion, ex hoc nunc et usque in æternum.
text_pt: E da que coxeava farei um remanescente, e da que tinha sido arrojada para longe, uma nação poderosa; e o Senhor reinará sobre eles no monte Sião, desde agora e para sempre.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι τὴν συντετριμμένην εἰς ὑπόλειμμα καὶ τὴν ἀπωσμένην εἰς ἔθνος ἰσχυρόν καὶ βασιλεύσει κύριος ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν ὄρει Σιων ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And you, O cloudy tower of the flock, of the daughter of Sion, unto you shall it come: yea the first power shall come, the kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem .
text_la: Et tu, turris gregis nebulosa filiæ Sion, usque ad te veniet, et veniet potestas prima, regnum filiæ Jerusalem.
text_pt: E a ti, ó torre do rebanho, fortaleza da filha de Sião, a ti virá; sim, a ti virá o primeiro domínio, o reino da filha de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ σύ πύργος ποιμνίου αὐχμώδης θύγατερ Σιων ἐπὶ σὲ ἥξει καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ἡ ἀρχὴ ἡ πρώτη βασιλεία ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος τῇ θυγατρὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Now, why are you drawn together with grief? Have you no king in you, or is your counselor perished, because sorrow has taken you as a woman in labour.
text_la: Nunc quare mœrore contraheris? numquid rex non est tibi, aut consiliarius tuus periit, quia comprehendit te dolor sicut parturientem?
text_pt: E agora, por que fazes tão grande pranto? Não há em ti rei? Pereceu o teu conselheiro? Apoderou-se de ti a dor, como da que está de parto?
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἵνα τί ἔγνως κακά μὴ βασιλεὺς οὐκ ἦν σοι ἢ ἡ βουλή σου ἀπώλετο ὅτι κατεκράτησάν σου ὠδῖνες ὡς τικτούσης

text_en: Be in pain and labour, O daughter of Sion, as a woman that brings forth: for now shall you go out of the city, and shall dwell in the country, and shall come even to Babylon , there you shall be delivered: there the Lord will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.
text_la: Dole et satage, filia Sion, quasi parturiens, quia nunc egredieris de civitate, et habitabis in regione, et venies usque ad Babylonem : ibi liberaberis, ibi redimet te Dominus de manu inimicorum tuorum.
text_pt: Sofre dores, e trabalha, para dar à luz, ó filha de Sião, como a que está de parto, porque agora sairás da cidade, e morarás no campo, e virás até babilônia; ali, porém, serás livrada; ali te remirá o SENHOR da mão de teus inimigos.
text_el: ὤδινε καὶ ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἔγγιζε θύγατερ Σιων ὡς τίκτουσα διότι νῦν ἐξελεύσῃ ἐκ πόλεως καὶ κατασκηνώσεις ἐν πεδίῳ καὶ ἥξεις ἕως Βαβυλῶνος ἐκεῖθεν ῥύσεταί σε καὶ ἐκεῖθεν λυτρώσεταί σε κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν σου

text_en: And now many nations are gathered together against you, and they say: Let her be stoned : and let our eye look upon Sion.
text_la: Et nunc congregatæ sunt super te gentes multæ, quæ dicunt : Lapidetur, et aspiciat in Sion oculus noster.
text_pt: Agora se congregaram muitas nações contra ti, que dizem: Seja profanada, e vejam os nossos olhos o seu desejo sobre Sião.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐπισυνήχθη ἐπὶ σὲ ἔθνη πολλὰ οἱ λέγοντες ἐπιχαρούμεθα καὶ ἐπόψονται ἐπὶ Σιων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: But they have not known the thoughts of the Lord , and have not understood his counsel: because he has gathered them together as the hay of the floor.
text_la: Ipsi autem non cognoverunt cogitationes Domini, et non intellexerunt consilium ejus, quia congregavit eos quasi fœnum areæ.
text_pt: Mas não sabem os pensamentos do Senhor, nem entendem o seu conselho; porque as ajuntou como gavelas numa eira.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν λογισμὸν κυρίου καὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὴν βουλὴν αὐτοῦ ὅτι συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ὡς δράγματα ἅλωνος

text_en: Arise, and tread, O daughter of Sion: for I will make your horn iron, and your hoofs I will make brass: and you shall beat in pieces many peoples, and shall immolate the spoils of them to the Lord , and their strength to the Lord of the whole earth.
text_la: Surge, et tritura, filia Sion, quia cornu tuum ponam ferreum, et ungulas tuas ponam æreas; et comminues populos multos, et interficies Domino rapinas eorum, et fortitudinem eorum Domino universæ terræ.
text_pt: Levanta-te e trilha, ó filha de Sião; porque eu farei de ferro o teu chifre, e de bronze as tuas unhas; e esmiuçarás a muitos povos, e o seu ganho será consagrado ao Senhor, e os seus bens ao Senhor de toda a terra.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι καὶ ἀλόα αὐτούς θύγατερ Σιων ὅτι τὰ κέρατά σου θήσομαι σιδηρᾶ καὶ τὰς ὁπλάς σου θήσομαι χαλκᾶς καὶ κατατήξεις ἐν αὐτοῖς ἔθνη καὶ λεπτυνεῖς λαοὺς πολλοὺς καὶ ἀναθήσεις τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτῶν τῷ κυρίῳ πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: Now shall you be laid waste, O daughter of the robber: they have laid siege against us, with a rod shall they strike the cheek of the judge of Israel .
text_la: Nunc vastaberis, filia latronis. Obsidionem posuerunt super nos : in virga percutient maxillam judicis Israël.
text_el: νῦν ἐμφραχθήσεται θυγάτηρ Εφραιμ ἐν φραγμῷ συνοχὴν ἔταξεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν ῥάβδῳ πατάξουσιν ἐπὶ σιαγόνα τὰς φυλὰς τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And you Bethlehem Ephrata , are a little one among the thousands of Juda , out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be the ruler in Israel : and his going forth is from the beginning, from the days of eternity .
text_la: Et tu, Bethlehem Ephrata, parvulus es in millibus Juda; ex te mihi egredietur qui sit dominator in Israël, et egressus ejus ab initio, a diebus æternitatis.
text_pt: Agora ajunta-te em tropas, ó filha de tropas; pôr-se-á cerco contra nós; ferirão com a vara na face ao juiz de Israel.
text_el: καὶ σύ Βηθλεεμ οἶκος τοῦ Εφραθα ὀλιγοστὸς εἶ τοῦ εἶναι ἐν χιλιάσιν Ιουδα ἐκ σοῦ μοι ἐξελεύσεται τοῦ εἶναι εἰς ἄρχοντα ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ αἱ ἔξοδοι αὐτοῦ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἐξ ἡμερῶν αἰῶνος

text_en: Therefore will he give them up even till the time wherein she that travails shall bring forth: and the remnant of his brethren shall be converted to the children of Israel .
text_la: Propter hoc dabit eos usque ad tempus in quo parturiens pariet, et reliquiæ fratrum ejus convertentur ad filios Israël.
text_pt: E tu, Belém Efrata, posto que pequena entre os milhares de Judá, de ti me sairá o que governará em Israel, e cujas saídas são desde os tempos antigos, desde os dias da eternidade.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο δώσει αὐτοὺς ἕως καιροῦ τικτούσης τέξεται καὶ οἱ ἐπίλοιποι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: And he shall stand, and feed in the strength of the Lord , in the height of the name of the Lord , his God : and they shall be converted , for now shall he be magnified even to the ends of the earth.
text_la: Et stabit, et pascet in fortitudine Domini, in sublimitate nominis Domini Dei sui : et convertentur, quia nunc magnificabitur usque ad terminos terræ.
text_pt: Portanto os entregará até ao tempo em que a que está de parto tiver dado à luz; então o restante de seus irmãos voltará aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ στήσεται καὶ ὄψεται καὶ ποιμανεῖ τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἰσχύι κυρίου καὶ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ ὀνόματος κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν ὑπάρξουσιν διότι νῦν μεγαλυνθήσεται ἕως ἄκρων τῆς γῆς

text_en: And this man shall be our peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land, and when he shall set his foot in our houses: and we shall raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men .
text_la: Et erit iste pax : cum venerit Assyrius in terram nostram, et quando calcaverit domibus nostris, et suscitabimus super eum septem pastores et octo primates homines;
text_pt: E ele permanecerá, e apascentará ao povo na força do Senhor, na excelência do nome do Senhor seu Deus; e eles permanecerão, porque agora será engrandecido até aos fins da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται αὕτη εἰρήνη ὅταν Ἀσσύριος ἐπέλθῃ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν καὶ ὅταν ἐπιβῇ ἐπὶ τὴν χώραν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπεγερθήσονται ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἑπτὰ ποιμένες καὶ ὀκτὼ δήγματα ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And they shall feed the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nemrod with the spears thereof: and he shall deliver us from the Assyrian when he shall come into our land, and when he shall tread in our borders.
text_la: et pascent terram Assur in gladio, et terram Nemrod in lanceis ejus, et liberabit ab Assur cum venerit in terram nostram, et cum calcaverit in finibus nostris.
text_pt: E este será a nossa paz; quando a Assíria vier à nossa terra, e quando pisar em nossos palácios, levantaremos contra ela sete pastores e oito príncipes dentre os homens.
text_el: καὶ ποιμανοῦσιν τὸν Ασσουρ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Νεβρωδ ἐν τῇ τάφρῳ αὐτῆς καὶ ῥύσεται ἐκ τοῦ Ασσουρ ὅταν ἐπέλθῃ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν καὶ ὅταν ἐπιβῇ ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια ὑμῶν

text_en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples, as a dew from the Lord , and as drops upon the grass, which waits not for man , nor tarries for the children of men .
text_la: Et erunt reliquiæ Jacob in medio populorum multorum quasi ros a Domino, et quasi stillæ super herbam, quæ non exspectat virum, et non præstolatur filios hominum.
text_pt: Esses consumirão a terra da Assíria à espada, e a terra de Ninrode nas suas entradas. Assim nos livrará da Assíria, quando vier à nossa terra, e quando calcar os nossos termos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ ὑπόλειμμα τοῦ Ιακωβ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν μέσῳ λαῶν πολλῶν ὡς δρόσος παρὰ κυρίου πίπτουσα καὶ ὡς ἄρνες ἐπὶ ἄγρωστιν ὅπως μὴ συναχθῇ μηδεὶς μηδὲ ὑποστῇ ἐν υἱοῖς ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles , in the midst of many peoples, as a lion among the beasts of the forests, and as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, when he shall go through, and tread down, and take there is none to deliver.
text_la: Et erunt reliquiæ Jacob in gentibus, in medio populorum multorum, quasi leo in jumentis silvarum, et quasi catulus leonis in gregibus pecorum, qui cum transierit, et conculcaverit, et ceperit, non est qui eruat.
text_pt: E o remanescente de Jacó estará no meio de muitos povos, como orvalho da parte do Senhor, como chuvisco sobre a erva, que não espera pelo homem, nem aguarda a filhos de homens.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ ὑπόλειμμα τοῦ Ιακωβ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν μέσῳ λαῶν πολλῶν ὡς λέων ἐν κτήνεσιν ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ καὶ ὡς σκύμνος ἐν ποιμνίοις προβάτων ὃν τρόπον ὅταν διέλθῃ καὶ διαστείλας ἁρπάσῃ καὶ μὴ ᾖ ὁ ἐξαιρούμενος

text_en: Your hand shall be lifted up over your enemies, and all your enemies shall be cut off.
text_la: Exaltabitur manus tua super hostes tuos, et omnes inimici tui interibunt.
text_pt: E o restante de Jacó estará entre os gentios, no meio de muitos povos, como um leão entre os animais do bosque, como um leãozinho entre os rebanhos de ovelhas, o qual, quando passar, pisará e despedaçará, sem que haja quem as livre.
text_el: ὑψωθήσεται ἡ χείρ σου ἐπὶ τοὺς θλίβοντάς σε καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἐξολεθρευθήσονται

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord , that I will take away your horses out of the midst of you, and will destroy your chariots.
text_la: Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus : auferam equos tuos de medio tui, et disperdam quadrigas tuas.
text_pt: A tua mão se exaltará sobre os teus adversários; e todos os teus inimigos serão exterminados.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος ἐξολεθρεύσω τοὺς ἵππους σου ἐκ μέσου σου καὶ ἀπολῶ τὰ ἅρματά σου

text_en: And I will destroy the cities of your land, and will throw down all your strong holds,
text_la: Et perdam civitates terræ tuæ,
text_pt: E sucederá naquele dia, diz o Senhor, que eu exterminarei do meio de ti os teus cavalos, e destruirei os teus carros.
text_el: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω τὰς πόλεις τῆς γῆς σου καὶ ἐξαρῶ πάντα τὰ ὀχυρώματά σου

text_en: and I will take away sorceries out of your hand, and there shall be no divinations in you.
text_la: et destruam omnes munitiones tuas : et auferam maleficia de manu tua, et divinationes non erunt in te :
text_pt: E destruirei as cidades da tua terra, e derrubarei todas as tuas fortalezas;
text_el: καὶ ἐξαρῶ τὰ φάρμακά σου ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν σου καὶ ἀποφθεγγόμενοι οὐκ ἔσονται ἐν σοί

text_en: And I will destroy your graven things, and your statues, out of the midst of you: and you shall no more adore the works of your hands.
text_la: et perire faciam sculptilia tua et statuas tuas de medio tui, et non adorabis ultra opera manuum tuarum :
text_pt: E exterminarei as feitiçarias da tua mão; e não terás adivinhadores;
text_el: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω τὰ γλυπτά σου καὶ τὰς στήλας σου ἐκ μέσου σου καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ προσκυνήσῃς τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν σου

text_en: And I will pluck up your groves out of the midst of you: and will crush your cities.
text_la: et evellam lucos tuos de medio tui, et conteram civitates tuas.
text_pt: E destruirei do meio de ti as tuas imagens de escultura e as tuas estátuas; e tu não te inclinarás mais diante da obra das tuas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐκκόψω τὰ ἄλση σου ἐκ μέσου σου καὶ ἀφανιῶ τὰς πόλεις σου

text_en: And I will execute vengeance in wrath , and in indignation, among all the nations that have not given ear.
text_la: Et faciam, in furore et in indignatione, ultionem in omnibus gentibus quæ non audierunt.
text_pt: E arrancarei os teus bosques do meio de ti; e destruirei as tuas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω ἐν ὀργῇ καὶ ἐν θυμῷ ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν

text_en: Hear what the Lord says: Arise, contend in judgment against the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
text_la: Audite quæ Dominus loquitur : Surge, contende judicio adversum montes, et audiant colles vocem tuam.
text_pt: Ouvi agora o que diz o SENHOR: Levanta-te, contende com os montes, e ouçam os outeiros a tua voz.
text_el: ἀκούσατε δὴ λόγον κυρίου κύριος εἶπεν ἀνάστηθι κρίθητι πρὸς τὰ ὄρη καὶ ἀκουσάτωσαν οἱ βουνοὶ φωνήν σου

text_en: Let the mountains hear the judgment of the Lord , and the strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord will enter into judgment with his people, and he will plead against Israel .
text_la: Audiant montes judicium Domini, et fortia fundamenta terræ; quia judicium Domini cum populo suo, et cum Israël dijudicabitur.
text_pt: Ouvi, montes, a demanda do Senhor, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra; porque o Senhor tem uma demanda com o seu povo, e com Israel entrará em juízo.
text_el: ἀκούσατε βουνοί τὴν κρίσιν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ αἱ φάραγγες θεμέλια τῆς γῆς ὅτι κρίσις τῷ κυρίῳ πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ μετὰ τοῦ Ισραηλ διελεγχθήσεται

text_en: O my people, what have I done to you, or in what have I molested you? Answer me.
text_la: Popule meus, quid feci tibi? aut quid molestus fui tibi? Responde mihi.
text_pt: Ó povo meu; que te tenho feito? E com que te enfadei? Testifica contra mim.
text_el: λαός μου τί ἐποίησά σοι ἢ τί ἐλύπησά σε ἢ τί παρηνώχλησά σοι ἀποκρίθητί μοι

text_en: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt , and delivered you out of the house of slaves: and I sent before your face Moses , and Aaron , and Mary.
text_la: Quia eduxi te de terra Ægypti, et de domo servientium liberavi te, et misi ante faciem tuam Moysen, et Aaron, et Mariam.
text_pt: Pois te fiz subir da terra do Egito, e da casa da servidão te remi; e enviei adiante de ti a Moisés, Arão e Miriã.
text_el: διότι ἀνήγαγόν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας ἐλυτρωσάμην σε καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα πρὸ προσώπου σου τὸν Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ Μαριαμ

text_en: O my people, remember, I pray you, what Balach, the king of Moab , purposed: and what Balaam, the son of Beor , answered him, from Setim to Galgal, that you might know the justice of the Lord .
text_la: Popule meus, memento, quæso, quid cogitaverit Balach, rex Moab, et quid responderit ei Balaam, filius Beor, de Setim usque ad Galgalam, ut cognosceres justitias Domini.
text_pt: Povo meu, lembra-te agora do que consultou Balaque, rei de Moabe, e o que lhe respondeu Balaão, filho de Beor, e do que aconteceu desde Sitim até Gilgal, para que conheças as justiças do Senhor.
text_el: λαός μου μνήσθητι δὴ τί ἐβουλεύσατο κατὰ σοῦ Βαλακ βασιλεὺς Μωαβ καὶ τί ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Βαλααμ υἱὸς τοῦ Βεωρ ἀπὸ τῶν σχοίνων ἕως τοῦ Γαλγαλ ὅπως γνωσθῇ ἡ δικαιοσύνη τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: What shall I offer to the Lord that is worthy? Wherewith shall I kneel before the high God ? Shall I offer holocausts unto him, and calves of a year old?
text_la: Quid dignum offeram Domino? curvabo genu Deo excelso? Numquid offeram ei holocautomata et vitulos anniculos?
text_pt: Com que me apresentarei ao Senhor, e me inclinarei diante do Deus altíssimo? Apresentar-me-ei diante dele com holocaustos, com bezerros de um ano?
text_el: ἐν τίνι καταλάβω τὸν κύριον ἀντιλήμψομαι θεοῦ μου ὑψίστου εἰ καταλήμψομαι αὐτὸν ἐν ὁλοκαυτώμασιν ἐν μόσχοις ἐνιαυσίοις

text_en: May the Lord be appeased with thousands of rams, or with many thousands of fat he goats? Shall I give my firstborn for my wickedness , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?
text_la: numquid placari potest Dominus in millibus arietum, aut in multis millibus hircorum pinguium? numquid dabo primogenitum meum pro scelere meo, fructum ventris mei pro peccato animæ meæ?
text_pt: Agradar-se-á o Senhor de milhares de carneiros, ou de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? Darei o meu primogênito pela minha transgressão, o fruto do meu ventre pelo pecado da minha alma?
text_el: εἰ προσδέξεται κύριος ἐν χιλιάσιν κριῶν ἢ ἐν μυριάσιν χειμάρρων πιόνων εἰ δῶ πρωτότοκά μου ἀσεβείας καρπὸν κοιλίας μου ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτίας ψυχῆς μου

text_en: I will show you, O man , what is good , and what the Lord requires of you: Verily to do judgment, and to love mercy, and to walk solicitous with your God .
text_la: Indicabo tibi, o homo, quid sit bonum, et quid Dominus requirat a te : utique facere judicium, et diligere misericordiam, et sollicitum ambulare cum Deo tuo.
text_pt: Ele te declarou, ó homem, o que é bom; e que é o que o Senhor pede de ti, senão que pratiques a justiça, e ames a benignidade, e andes humildemente com o teu Deus?
text_el: εἰ ἀνηγγέλη σοι ἄνθρωπε τί καλόν ἢ τί κύριος ἐκζητεῖ παρὰ σοῦ ἀλλ' ἢ τοῦ ποιεῖν κρίμα καὶ ἀγαπᾶν ἔλεον καὶ ἕτοιμον εἶναι τοῦ πορεύεσθαι μετὰ κυρίου θεοῦ σου

text_en: The voice of the Lord cries to the city, and salvation shall be to them that fear your name : hear O you tribes, and who shall approve it?
text_la: Vox Domini ad civitatem clamat, et salus erit timentibus nomen tuum : audite, tribus, et quis approbabit illud?
text_pt: A voz do Senhor clama à cidade e o que é sábio verá o teu nome. Ouvi a vara, e quem a ordenou.
text_el: φωνὴ κυρίου τῇ πόλει ἐπικληθήσεται καὶ σώσει φοβουμένους τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἄκουε φυλή καὶ τίς κοσμήσει πόλιν

text_en: As yet there is a fire in the house of the wicked , the treasures of iniquity , and a scant measure full of wrath .
text_la: Adhuc ignis in domo impii thesauri iniquitatis, et mensura minor iræ plena.
text_pt: Ainda há na casa do ímpio tesouros da impiedade, e medida escassa, que é detestável?
text_el: μὴ πῦρ καὶ οἶκος ἀνόμου θησαυρίζων θησαυροὺς ἀνόμους καὶ μετὰ ὕβρεως ἀδικία

text_en: Shall I justify wicked balances, and the deceitful weights of the bag?
text_la: Numquid justificabo stateram impiam, et saccelli pondera dolosa?
text_pt: Seria eu limpo com balanças falsas, e com uma bolsa de pesos enganosos?
text_el: εἰ δικαιωθήσεται ἐν ζυγῷ ἄνομος καὶ ἐν μαρσίππῳ στάθμια δόλου

text_en: By which her rich men were filled with iniquity , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue was deceitful in their mouth.
text_la: In quibus divites ejus repleti sunt iniquitate, et habitantes in ea loquebantur mendacium, et lingua eorum fraudulenta in ore eorum.
text_pt: Porque os seus ricos estão cheios de violência, e os seus habitantes falam mentiras e a sua língua é enganosa na sua boca.
text_el: ἐξ ὧν τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτῶν ἀσεβείας ἔπλησαν καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτὴν ἐλάλουν ψευδῆ καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν ὑψώθη ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: And I therefore began to strike you with desolation for your sins .
text_la: Et ego ergo cœpi percutere te perditione super peccatis tuis.
text_pt: Assim eu também te enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por causa dos teus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἄρξομαι τοῦ πατάξαι σε ἀφανιῶ σε ἐπὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις σου

text_en: You shall eat, but shall not be filled: and your humiliation shall be in the midst of you: and you shall take hold, but shall not save: and those whom you shall save, I will give up to the sword.
text_la: Tu comedes, et non saturaberis, et humiliatio tua in medio tui : et apprehendes, et non salvabis, et quos salvaveris, in gladium dabo.
text_pt: Tu comerás, mas não te fartarás, e a tua humilhação estará no meio de ti; removerás os teus bens mas não livrarás; e aquilo que livrares, eu o entregarei à espada.
text_el: σὺ φάγεσαι καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῇς καὶ σκοτάσει ἐν σοὶ καὶ ἐκνεύσει καὶ οὐ μὴ διασωθῇς καὶ ὅσοι ἐὰν διασωθῶσιν εἰς ῥομφαίαν παραδοθήσονται

text_en: You shall sow, but shall not reap: you shall tread the olives, but shall not be anointed with the oil: and the new wine, but shall not drink the wine.
text_la: Tu seminabis, et non metes : tu calcabis olivam, et non ungeris oleo; et mustum, et non bibes vinum.
text_pt: Tu semearás, mas não segarás; pisarás a azeitona, mas não te ungirás com azeite; e pisarás o mosto, mas não beberás vinho.
text_el: σὺ σπερεῖς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀμήσῃς σὺ πιέσεις ἐλαίαν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀλείψῃ ἔλαιον καὶ οἶνον καὶ οὐ μὴ πίητε καὶ ἀφανισθήσεται νόμιμα λαοῦ μου

text_en: For you have kept the statutes of Amri, and all the works of the house of Achab : and you have walked according to their wills, that I should make you a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof a hissing, and you shall bear the reproach of my people.
text_la: Et custodisti præcepta Amri, et omne opus domus Achab, et ambulasti in voluntatibus eorum : ut darem te in perditionem, et habitantes in ea in sibilum, et opprobrium populi mei portabitis.
text_pt: Porque se observam os estatutos de Onri, e toda a obra da casa de Acabe, e andais nos conselhos deles; para que eu te faça uma desolação, e dos seus habitantes um assobio; assim trareis sobre vós o opróbrio do meu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐφύλαξας τὰ δικαιώματα Ζαμβρι καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα οἴκου Αχααβ καὶ ἐπορεύθητε ἐν ταῖς βουλαῖς αὐτῶν ὅπως παραδῶ σε εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας αὐτὴν εἰς συρισμόν καὶ ὀνείδη λαῶν λήμψεσθε

text_en: Woe is me, for I have become as one that gleans in autumn the grapes of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat, my soul desired the first ripe figs.
text_la: Væ mihi, quia factus sum sicut qui colligit in autumno racemos vindemiæ! non est botrus ad comedendum, præcoquas ficus desideravit anima mea.
text_pt: Ai de mim! porque estou feito como as colheitas de frutas do verão, como os rabiscos da vindima; não há cacho de uvas para comer, nem figos temporãos que a minha alma deseja.
text_el: οἴμμοι ὅτι ἐγενόμην ὡς συνάγων καλάμην ἐν ἀμήτῳ καὶ ὡς ἐπιφυλλίδα ἐν τρυγήτῳ οὐχ ὑπάρχοντος βότρυος τοῦ φαγεῖν τὰ πρωτόγονα οἴμμοι ψυχή

text_en: The holy man is perished out of the earth, and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood, every one hunts his brother to death.
text_la: Periit sanctus de terra, et rectus in hominibus non est : omnes in sanguine insidiantur; vir fratrem suum ad mortem venatur.
text_pt: Já pereceu da terra o homem piedoso, e não há entre os homens um que seja justo; todos armam ciladas para sangue; cada um caça a seu irmão com a rede,
text_el: ὅτι ἀπόλωλεν εὐλαβὴς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατορθῶν ἐν ἀνθρώποις οὐχ ὑπάρχει πάντες εἰς αἵματα δικάζονται ἕκαστος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐκθλίβουσιν ἐκθλιβῇ

text_en: The evil of their hands they call good : the prince requires, and the judge is for giving: and the great man has uttered the desire of his soul , and they have troubled it.
text_la: Malum manuum suarum dicunt bonum : princeps postulat, et judex in reddendo est; et magnus locutus est desiderium animæ suæ, et conturbaverunt eam.
text_pt: As suas mãos fazem diligentemente o mal; assim demanda o príncipe, e o juiz julga pela recompensa, e o grande fala da corrupção da sua alma, e assim todos eles tecem o mal.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὸ κακὸν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἑτοιμάζουσιν ὁ ἄρχων αἰτεῖ καὶ ὁ κριτὴς εἰρηνικοὺς λόγους ἐλάλησεν καταθύμιον ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἐστιν καὶ ἐξελοῦμαι

text_en: He that is best among them, is as a brier, and he that is righteous, as the thorn of the hedge. The day of your inspection, your visitation comes: now shall be their destruction.
text_la: Qui optimus in eis est, quasi paliurus, et qui rectus, quasi spina de sepe. Dies speculationis tuæ, visitatio tua venit : nunc erit vastitas eorum.
text_pt: O melhor deles é como um espinho; o mais reto é pior do que a sebe de espinhos; veio o dia dos teus vigias, veio o dia da tua punição; agora será a sua confusão.
text_el: τὰ ἀγαθὰ αὐτῶν ὡς σὴς ἐκτρώγων καὶ βαδίζων ἐπὶ κανόνος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σκοπιᾶς οὐαὶ οὐαί αἱ ἐκδικήσεις σου ἥκασιν νῦν ἔσονται κλαυθμοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: Believe not a friend, and trust not in a prince: keep the doors of your mouth from her that sleeps in your bosom.
text_la: Nolite credere amico, et nolite confidere in duce : ab ea quæ dormit in sinu tuo custodi claustra oris tui.
text_pt: Não creiais no amigo, nem confieis no vosso guia; daquela que repousa no teu seio, guarda as portas da tua boca.
text_el: μὴ καταπιστεύετε ἐν φίλοις καὶ μὴ ἐλπίζετε ἐπὶ ἡγουμένοις ἀπὸ τῆς συγκοίτου σου φύλαξαι τοῦ ἀναθέσθαι τι αὐτῇ

text_en: For the son dishonours the father, and the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law: and a man's enemies are they of his own household.
text_la: Quia filius contumeliam facit patri, et filia consurgit adversus matrem suam : nurus adversus socrum suam, et inimici hominis domestici ejus.
text_pt: Porque o filho despreza ao pai, a filha se levanta contra sua mãe, a nora contra sua sogra, os inimigos do homem são os da sua própria casa.
text_el: διότι υἱὸς ἀτιμάζει πατέρα θυγάτηρ ἐπαναστήσεται ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτῆς νύμφη ἐπὶ τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτῆς ἐχθροὶ ἀνδρὸς πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But I will look towards the Lord , I will wait for God , my saviour: my God will hear me.
text_la: Ego autem ad Dominum aspiciam; exspectabo Deum, salvatorem meum : audiet me Deus meus.
text_pt: Eu, porém, olharei para o Senhor; esperarei no Deus da minha salvação; o meu Deus me ouvirá.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἐπιβλέψομαι ὑπομενῶ ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου εἰσακούσεταί μου ὁ θεός μου

text_en: Rejoice not, you my enemy, over me, because I am fallen: I shall arise, when I sit in darkness, the Lord is my light.
text_la: Ne læteris, inimica mea, super me, quia cecidi : consurgam cum sedero in tenebris : Dominus lux mea est.
text_pt: Ó inimiga minha, não te alegres a meu respeito; ainda que eu tenha caído, levantar-me-ei; se morar nas trevas, o Senhor será a minha luz.
text_el: μὴ ἐπίχαιρέ μοι ἡ ἐχθρά μου ὅτι πέπτωκα καὶ ἀναστήσομαι διότι ἐὰν καθίσω ἐν τῷ σκότει κύριος φωτιεῖ μοι

text_en: I will bear the wrath of the Lord , because I have sinned against him: until he judge my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth into the light, I shall behold his justice .
text_la: Iram Domini portabo, quoniam peccavi ei, donec causam meam judicet, et faciat judicium meum. Educet me in lucem : videbo justitiam ejus.
text_pt: Sofrerei a ira do Senhor, porque pequei contra ele, até que julgue a minha causa, e execute o meu direito; ele me tirará para a luz, e eu verei a sua justiça.
text_el: ὀργὴν κυρίου ὑποίσω ὅτι ἥμαρτον αὐτῷ ἕως τοῦ δικαιῶσαι αὐτὸν τὴν δίκην μου καὶ ποιήσει τὸ κρίμα μου καὶ ἐξάξει με εἰς τὸ φῶς ὄψομαι τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ

text_en: And my enemy shall behold, and she shall be covered with shame, who says to me: Where is the Lord your God ? My eyes shall look down upon her: now shall she be trodden under foot as the mire of the streets.
text_la: Et aspiciet inimica mea, et operietur confusione, quæ dicit ad me : Ubi est Dominus Deus tuus? Oculi mei videbunt in eam : nunc erit in conculcationem ut lutum platearum.
text_pt: E a minha inimiga verá isso, e cobri-la-á a vergonha, que me diz: Onde está o Senhor teu Deus? Os meus olhos a contemplarão; agora será ela pisada como a lama das ruas.
text_el: καὶ ὄψεται ἡ ἐχθρά μου καὶ περιβαλεῖται αἰσχύνην ἡ λέγουσα πρός με ποῦ κύριος ὁ θεός σου οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπόψονται αὐτήν νῦν ἔσται εἰς καταπάτημα ὡς πηλὸς ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς

text_en: The day shall come, that your walls may be built up: in that day shall the law be far removed.
text_la: Dies, ut ædificentur maceriæ tuæ; in die illa longe fiet lex.
text_pt: No dia em que reedificar os teus muros, nesse dia estará longe e dilatado o estatuto.
text_el: ἡμέρας ἀλοιφῆς πλίνθου ἐξάλειψίς σου ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη καὶ ἀποτρίψεται νόμιμά σου

text_en: In that day they shall come even from Assyria to you, and to the fortified cities: and from the fortified cities even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
text_la: In die illa et usque ad te veniet de Assur, et usque ad civitates munitas, et a civitatibus munitis usque ad flumen, et ad mare de mari, et ad montem de monte.
text_pt: Naquele dia virá a ti, desde a Assíria e das cidades fortificadas, e das cidades fortificadas até ao rio, e do mar até ao mar, e da montanha até à montanha.
text_el: ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη καὶ αἱ πόλεις σου ἥξουσιν εἰς ὁμαλισμὸν καὶ εἰς διαμερισμὸν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ αἱ πόλεις σου αἱ ὀχυραὶ εἰς διαμερισμὸν ἀπὸ Τύρου ἕως τοῦ ποταμοῦ Συρίας ἡμέρα ὕδατος καὶ θορύβου

text_en: And the land shall be made desolate because of the inhabitants thereof, and for the fruit of their devices.
text_la: Et terra erit in desolationem propter habitatores suos, et propter fructum cogitationum eorum.
text_pt: Mas esta terra será posta em desolação, por causa dos seus moradores, por causa do fruto das suas obras.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ γῆ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν σὺν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτὴν ἐκ καρπῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: Feed your people with your rod, the flock of your inheritance, them that dwell alone in the forest, in the midst of Carmel : they shall feed in Basan and Galaad, according to the days of old.
text_la: Pasce populum tuum in virga tua, gregem hæreditatis tuæ, habitantes solos, in saltu, in medio Carmeli. Pascentur Basan et Galaad juxta dies antiquos.
text_pt: Apascenta o teu povo com a tua vara, o rebanho da tua herança, que habita a sós, no bosque, no meio do Carmelo; apascentem-se em Basã e Gileade, como nos dias do passado.
text_el: ποίμαινε λαόν σου ἐν ῥάβδῳ σου πρόβατα κληρονομίας σου κατασκηνοῦντας καθ' ἑαυτοὺς δρυμὸν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Καρμήλου νεμήσονται τὴν Βασανῖτιν καὶ τὴν Γαλααδῖτιν καθὼς αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: According to the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt , I will show him wonders.
text_la: Secundum dies egressionis tuæ de terra Ægypti, ostendam ei mirabilia.
text_pt: Eu lhes mostrarei maravilhas, como nos dias da tua saída da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐξοδίας σου ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ὄψεσθε θαυμαστά

text_en: The nations shall see, and shall be confounded at all their strength: they shall put the hand upon the mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
text_la: Videbunt gentes, et confundentur super omni fortitudine sua. Ponent manum super os, aures eorum surdæ erunt.
text_pt: As nações o verão, e envergonhar-se-ão, por causa de todo o seu poder; porão a mão sobre a boca, e os seus ouvidos ficarão surdos.
text_el: ὄψονται ἔθνη καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐκ πάσης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτῶν ἐπιθήσουσιν χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν ἀποκωφωθήσονται

text_en: They shall lick the dust like serpents, as the creeping things of the earth, they shall be disturbed in their houses: they shall dread the Lord , our God , and shall fear you.
text_la: Lingent pulverem sicut serpentes; velut reptilia terræ perturbabuntur in ædibus suis. Dominum Deum nostrum formidabunt, et timebunt te.
text_pt: Lamberão o pó como serpente, como vermes da terra, tremendo, sairão dos seus esconderijos; com pavor virão ao Senhor nosso Deus, e terão medo de ti.
text_el: λείξουσιν χοῦν ὡς ὄφεις σύροντες γῆν συγχυθήσονται ἐν συγκλεισμῷ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἐκστήσονται καὶ φοβηθήσονται ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: Who is a God like to you, who takes away iniquity , and passes by the sin of the remnant of your inheritance? He will send his fury in no more, because he delights in mercy.
text_la: Quis, Deus, similis tui, qui aufers iniquitatem, et transis peccatum reliquiarum hæreditatis tuæ? Non immittet ultra furorem suum, quoniam volens misericordiam est.
text_pt: Quem é Deus semelhante a ti, que perdoa a iniqüidade, e que passa por cima da rebelião do restante da sua herança? Ele não retém a sua ira para sempre, porque tem prazer na sua benignidade.
text_el: τίς θεὸς ὥσπερ σύ ἐξαίρων ἀδικίας καὶ ὑπερβαίνων ἀσεβείας τοῖς καταλοίποις τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ συνέσχεν εἰς μαρτύριον ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ ὅτι θελητὴς ἐλέους ἐστίν

text_en: He will turn again, and have mercy on us: he will put away our iniquities : and he will cast all our sins into the bottom of the sea.
text_la: Revertetur, et miserebitur nostri; deponet iniquitates nostras, et projiciet in profundum maris omnia peccata nostra.
text_pt: Tornará a apiedar-se de nós; sujeitará as nossas iniqüidades, e tu lançarás todos os seus pecados nas profundezas do mar.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐπιστρέψει καὶ οἰκτιρήσει ἡμᾶς καταδύσει τὰς ἀδικίας ἡμῶν καὶ ἀπορριφήσονται εἰς τὰ βάθη τῆς θαλάσσης πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν

text_en: You will perform the truth to Jacob , the mercy to Abraham : which you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
text_la: Dabis veritatem Jacob, misericordiam Abraham, quæ jurasti patribus nostris a diebus antiquis.
text_pt: Darás a Jacó a fidelidade, e a Abraão a benignidade, que juraste a nossos pais desde os dias antigos.
text_el: δώσεις ἀλήθειαν τῷ Ιακωβ ἔλεον τῷ Αβρααμ καθότι ὤμοσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν κατὰ τὰς ἡμέρας τὰς ἔμπροσθεν
